evals.prompt: I'm new on SellerGenome. Where do I make a backend change, how does it get live, and which skills should I load for changing the persona prompt and checking it on the live site?
evals.expected_output: Orientation answer with the v5 worktree, read-only production worktree, release path and the right skills.
expectations: Says to develop in .worktrees/v5 and never edit .worktrees/production
Names sellergenome-live-qa (or release-deploy) for verifying live
Mentions bumping the version in both settings files or the release skill

evals.prompt: quick: what are the hard rules I must not break when touching seller data in this project?
expectations: Mentions the 77 approved GLIDs for live upstream
Says no phone numbers/emails/contact names to an LLM
Says never delete volumes or run docker compose down -v
Says to label simulations and mocks
